Plan Name: Solar Buyback Advantage 12

  Average Monthly Use            500 kWh          1,000 kWh          2,000 kWh
  Average Price per kWh          16.9 cents        14.7 cents         13.6 cents

Energy Charge                              $0.145                      per kWh
Base Charge*                               $9.95                       per billing cycle
TDU Delivery Charge                        $0.050339                   per kWh
TDU Delivery Charge                        $4.23                       per billing cycle

Solar Buyback: TXU Energy Retail Company LLC will purchase your excess
distributed renewable generation at a rate of 3.0 cents per kWh. Credits for
excess generation are applied to energy charges only; the Base Charge and TDU
Delivery Charges above are not offsettable by Solar Buyback credits.

*Base Charge is not offsettable by any bill credit.

              Type of Product                                   Fixed Rate
              Contract Term                                     12 Months

              Do I have a termination fee or any fees associated with
              terminating service?         Yes, a termination fee of $150 applies
              if service ends before the end of the Contract Term.
